supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Solve “how many groups?” problems in a way that makes sense to them.
teachingSteps: Identify total objects, group size and number of groups.
Represent equal sharing or the number of equal groups.
Interpret what the quotient counts in the story.
